title: 考试是否通过
problem_statement_md:
要想在大学学习，你必须在一次考试中获得高于或等于90分的的成绩
给定的程序输入考试分数。

完善代码，如果分数高于或等于90分，输出 "pass"，否则打印 "fail"。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The else statement [/h1] [/s0l0!-header]

To study at a university, you must score higher than or equal to 90 out of 100 [b]points [/b]on an exam.
The given program takes [b]points [/b]as input.

[b]Task[/b]
Complete the code to output "pass" if the score is higher than or equal to 90, otherwise print "fail".

[b]Sample Input[/b]
95
[b]
Sample Output[/b]
pass

[note]Use if/else statements.[/note]
